title: Regenerating/verifying OpenFeature React generated files
answers: How do I regenerate the OpenFeature React hooks and typings after changing a feature flag?
What command updates openfeature-types.gen.d.ts and the react hooks file?
How do I verify feature-toggle generated files are up to date?
body: Run `make gen-feature-toggles` to regenerate generated OpenFeature files (e.g. packages/grafana-runtime/src/internal/openFeature/openfeature-types.gen.d.ts) after editing registry flags or their Expression. Verify generation and typed mapping with `go test ./pkg/services/featuremgmt -run 'TestGenerateOpenFeatureReactForFlags|TestFeatureToggleFiles' -count=1`, and check consumer compile with `yarn typecheck`. TestFeatureToggleFiles uses verifyAndGenerateFile to compare generated output against the on-disk file, failing if they drift (pkg/services/featuremgmt/toggles_gen_test.go:TestFeatureToggleFiles).
applies: Any change to pkg/services/featuremgmt feature flag registry/templates affecting generated frontend OpenFeature files.

search: Regenerating OpenFeature React generated files requires running `make gen-feature-toggles` after editing registry flags or Expression. Verification uses `go test ./pkg/services/featuremgmt -run 'TestGenerateOpenFeatureReactForFlags|TestFeatureToggleFiles' -count=1` (which calls verifyAndGenerateFile in pkg/services/featuremgmt/toggles_gen_test.go:TestFeatureToggleFiles) and `yarn typecheck` to check consumer compilation. The test fails if generated output in packages/grafana-runtime/src/internal/openFeature/openfeature-types.gen.d.ts drifts from on-disk state. This applies to any change in pkg/services/featuremgmt feature flag registry or templates affecting generated frontend files.
